name: dell-networking-bom-advisor
description: Zero-install, client-side tool that builds technically-sound Dell PowerSwitch / NVIDIA Spectrum networking BOMs for storage & server attach. The app itself ships with no dependencies and runs by opening index.html.

comments.app: The application has ZERO runtime dependencies — index.html + js/ + styles.css run offline in any browser.
comments.test: The test battery uses jsdom for the DOM suites. Install it once (npm i) or point JSDOM_DIR at an existing jsdom. Suites needing it SKIP cleanly if absent.
comments.run: npm test  — runs all suites, exits non-zero on any failure (use as a pre-share gate). npm run build — packs the hosted single-file bundle.
